segments.he:
א.

בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁמְּשַׁגְּרִין עַל הָאָדָם אֶת הַיִּסּוּרִין, מַשְׁבִּיעִין עֲלֵיהֶם שֶׁלֹּא יֵלְכוּ אֶלָּא בְּיּוֹם פְּלוֹנִי וְלֹא יֵצְאוּ אֶלָּא בְּיוֹם פְּלוֹנִי וּבְשָׁעָה פְּלוֹנִית וְעַל־יְדֵי סַם פְּלוֹנִי. אֲבָל "תְּשׁוּבָה תְּפִלָּה וּצְדָקָה" מְבַטְּלִין הַשְּׁבוּעָה.
segments.en: Through proper judges, the Torah is beloved in the world.

segments.he:
ב.

חֲלִישׁוּת הַדַּעַת, הַיְנוּ עַצְבוּת עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא רֹעַ מַזָּל, וְעַל־יְדֵי רֹעַ מַזָּל מִדַּת הַדִּין שׁוֹלֵט.
segments.en: Due to the insults  with  which the judges are insulted, the crops – plagues  (curse)  fall upon it.

segments.he:
ג.

פָּרָשַׁת חֹשֶׁן – תִּקּוּן לְדִינִים.
segments.en: Through the insults which judges of Israel are insulted, through this inflation occurs in the world.

segments.he:
ד.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לָאָדָם צַעַר, יִתֵּן צְדָקָה, וְהַצְּדָקָה הֲוֵי כְּמוֹ שֶׁנּוֹתֵן שָׂכָר לָדוּן, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה הַדִּינִים נִמְתָּקִים, כִּי הַנּוֹטֵל שָׂכָר לָדוּן – דִּינָיו בְּטֵלִים.
segments.en: When an evil person becomes great, it becomes hard to deduce novel reasoning in Torah law, and also the words of judges are not accepted by the litigants.

segments.he:
ה.

עַד הֵיכָן תַּכְלִית הַיִּסּוּרִין.
segments.en: The renewal of national and local taxes is through (on account of)   the judges.

segments.he:
ו.

כֹּל שֶׁעָבְרוּ עָלָיו אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם בְּלֹא יִסּוּרִין, קִבֵּל עוֹלָמוֹ וּפֻרְעָנִיּוּת מְזֻמֶּנֶת לוֹ.
segments.en: ( Dinim – lit. this means judgments, and it refers to when things are going wrong or to any hardship or difficulty.  Din  – is singular,  Dinim - plural):

segments.he:
ז.

הַמּוֹכִיחַ אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, מוֹשְׁכִין עָלָיו חוּט שֶׁל חֶסֶד.
segments.en: At the time when suffering is sent upon a person, it is sworn not  to  commence  (lit. go or embark)  except on a specific day, and not to desist  (lit. leave)  except on a specific day and a specific hour, and through a specific medication. However, repentance, prayer and charity annul the oath.

segments.he:
ח.

שְׁלֹשָׁה דְּבָרִים מַזְכִּירִין עֲווֹנוֹתָיו שֶׁל אָדָם: קִיר נָטוּי וְעִיּוּן תְּפִלָּה וּמוֹסֵר דִּין עַל חֲבֵרוֹ.
segments.en: Being disheartened  (lit. weakness of the mind),  that is to say, depression, draws bad  fortune, and when one's fortune is bad, the attribute of harsh judgment dominates.

segments.he:
ט.

אַרְבָּעָה דְּבָרִים מְקָרְעִין גְּזַר־דִּינוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם: צְדָקָה, צְעָקָה, שִׁנּוּי־הַשֵּׁם, שִׁנוּי־מַעֲשֶׂה.
segments.en: The scriptural verses about the Choshen  (breast plate worn by the high priest)  is a tikun  (rectification or remedy)  for  D inim .

segments.he:
י.

צְעָקָה מוֹעִיל לְיָחִיד דַּוְקָא קֹדֶם גְּזַר־דִּין.
segments.en: When a person has pain, he should give charity. For the charity is like he's paying for the judgment, and through this the  Dinim ( defined at the beginning of this entry)  are lightened  (lit. sweetened).  Because someone who takes payment to judge, his rulings are void.

segments.he:
יא.

גְּזַר־דִּין שֶׁיֵּשׁ עִמּוֹ שְׁבוּעָה אֲפִלּוּ לְצִבּוּר אֵינוֹ מִתְקָרֵעַ.
segments.en: What is the extent of suffering?!

segments.he:
יב.

עַל־יְדֵי הַתַּעֲנִית שֶׁבִּשְׁנֵי רְעָבוֹן נִצּוֹל מִמִּיתָה מְשֻׁנָּה.
segments.en: Anyone who has gone forty days without suffering, he has received his world, and disasters are prepared for him.

segments.he:
יג.

כְּשֶׁנִּגְזָר עַל אָדָם אֵיזֶהוּ דִּין, נִגְזָר הַדִּין עָלָיו דַּוְקָא בְּמָקוֹם מְסֻיָּם, וְ עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יָכוֹל לְהַצִּיל עַצְמוֹ  בְּשִׁנּוּי מָקוֹם.
segments.en: One who chastises his fellow for the sake of Heaven, a thread of kindness is extended upon him.

segments.he:
יד.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ כְּאֵב עֵינַיִם אוֹ כְּאֵב מֵעַיִם, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁדִּינִין שׁוֹרִין עָלָיו.
segments.en: Three things call attention  to one's sins: A leaning wall,  prayer with concentration (with anticipation and examination to see its fulfillment) , and one who brings prosecution on his friend.

segments.he:
טו.

צָרִיךְ לְהוֹדִיעַ צַעֲרוֹ לָרַבִּים, וְרַבִּים יְבַקְשׁוּ עָלָיו רַחֲמִים.
segments.en: Four things tear up the  (bad)  edict on a man: Charity, crying out, changing one's name, and changing one's deeds.

segments.he:
טז.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ אֵיזֶהוּ דִּין עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, אֲזַי הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מוֹדִיעַ לַצַּדִּיקִים, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתְפַּלְּלוּ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּמִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִתְפַּלֵּל עֲלֵיהֶם, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־ הוּא כּוֹעֵס עָלָיו.
segments.en: Crying out helps an individual specifically before the edict.

segments.he:
יז.

כְּשֶׁרוֹאֶה אָדָם, שֶׁדִּינִין שׁוֹרִין עָלָיו, יְסַפֵּר מִשּׂוֹנְאָיו וְיַצְדִּיק אוֹתָם.
segments.en: A (Heavenly) decree that is accompanied by an oath, even for a group, cannot be torn.

segments.he:
יח.

עַל־יְדֵי הַעֲמָדַת דַּיָּנִים כְּשֵׁרִים נִתְבַּטֵּל הַצָּרוֹת.
segments.en: Through fasting in years of famine, one is saved from a  grotesque death.

segments.he:
יט.

מִי שֶׁנָּדַר, וְלֹא שִׁלֵּם נִדְרוֹ, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מֵבִיא עָלָיו יִסּוּרִין. וּכְשֶׁשּׁוֹתֵק נֶחְשָׁב לוֹ, כְּאִלּוּ שִׁלֵּם נֶדֶר.
segments.en: When some decree is decreed on a person, it is decreed on him specifically for a certain place. Through this he can save  [himself]  with a change of place.

segments.he:
כ.

הַמְקַבֵּל יִסּוּרִים בְּאַהֲבָה – כְּאִלּוּ הִקְרִיב קָרְבָּן.
segments.en: One who has pain in his eyes or stomach pains, it is certain that  Dinim (see title of this entry)  rest upon him.

segments.he:
כא.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם הוֹלֵךְ וְנוֹפֵל, סִימָן שֶׁנִּפְקָד לְמַעְלָה לְאֵיזֶה כִּשָּׁלוֹן.
segments.en: One should make his suffering known to the public, and the public will ask  ( in prayer)  for mercy on his behalf.

segments.he:
כב.

עַל־יְדֵי טְבִילַת מִקְוֶה נִתְבַּטֵּל הַצָּרוֹת וִישׁוּעָה בָּאָה.
segments.en: When there is some  D in (judgement or contention)  on the Jewish People, G-d forbid, the Holy One Blessed He notifies the tzadikim, so that they should pray for Israel, and whomever does not pray for them, the Holy One Blessed He is angry with them.

segments.he:
כג.

כְּשֶׁגּוֹזְרִין אֵיזֶה גְזַר  דִּין עַל הָאָדָם, קֹדֶם שֶׁיּוֹדְעִין מִזֶּה בְּנֵי־אָדָם הוּא בְּנָקֵל לְהִתְהַפֵּךְ.
segments.en: When a man sees that  Dinim  are weighing on him, he should talk about his enemies and justify them.

segments.he:
כד.

מִי שֶׁנּוֹפֵל מֵאֱמוּנָתוֹ, יֵדַע שֶׁדָּנִין אוֹתוֹ לְמַעְלָה
segments.en: Through the appointing of kosher judges, hardships are annulled.

segments.he:
כה.

מִי שֶׁדִּינִין שׁוֹרִין עָלָיו, יִסְתַּכֵּל בְּכָל פַּעַם עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם.
segments.en: One who made a vow and did not fulfill his vow, the Holy One Blessed He brings suffering upon him. When he is silent  (in response),  it is considered as if he has fulfilled his vow.

segments.he:
כו.

מִי שֶׁמּוֹרֶה דֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹב לָרְשָׁעִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַצְדִּיק אוֹתוֹ בַּדִּין.
segments.en: One who accepts suffering with love, it is considered as if he offered a sacrifice.

segments.he:
כז.

עַל־יְדֵי אֱמֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא עוֹשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד, שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְלֻבָּשׁ בְּדִין.
segments.en: When a man is walking and falls, it is a sign that he was met out from Above for a failure  (he had coming to him .  See  also  below #52. ).

segments.he:
כח.

מַה שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִמְּךָ, הוּא מֵחֲמַת כְּפִירו ֹ ת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּךָ.
segments.en: Through immersing in a  M ikveh , suffering is annulled and salvation comes.

segments.he:
כט.

עַל־יְדֵי בִּטָּחוֹן נִמְתָּק הַדִּין וְנִמְשָׁךְ הַחֶסֶד.
segments.en: When some harsh decree is passed on a man, before people know about it, it is easily overturned.

segments.he:
ל.

עַל־יְדֵי אֱמוּנָה תּוּכַל לְדַבֵּר וּלְהַנְהִיג אֶת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לִרְצוֹנְךָ.
segments.en: One who falls from his faith , should know that he is being judged from Above.

segments.he:
לא.

עַל־יְדֵי צְדָקָה מְהַפֵּךְ הַמִּשְׁפָּט וְהַדִּין לְמִדַּת חֶסֶד.
segments.en: One who has  Dinim  upon him should look frequently  (lit. every time)  upon the heavens.

segments.he:
לב.

מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ אֱמוּנָה, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא סִלֵּק חַסְדּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ.
segments.en: One who shows the good path to evildoers, the Holy One Blessed He justifies him in judgment.

segments.he:
לג.

כְּשֶׁדִּינִים שׁו ֹרִין וְהַחֶסֶד  יָקָר וְאֵינוֹ בַּנִּמְצָא, תֵּדַע שֶׁבְּכִיָּה מוֹעִיל לָזֶה. ( שָׁמַעְתִּי מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ בִּשְׁעַת כְּתִיבָתִי זֹאת לְפָנָיו, שֶׁרֶמֶז דָּבָר זֶה הוּא בַּפָּסוּק "מַה יָקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹקִים", פּ ֵרוּשׁ – מַה יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ ;  הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁהַחֶסֶד יָקָר וְאֵינוֹ בַּנִּמְצָא, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁדִּינִין שׁוֹרִין, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, אֲזַי הַפְּעֻלָּה לָזֶה – וּבְנֵי אָדָם בּ ְ'צֵל כְּ'נָפֶיךָ יֶ'חְסָיוּן ,  רָאשֵׁי־תֵבוֹת בֶּכִי, כִּי בְּכִיָּה מוֹעִיל לָזֶה כַּנַּ"ל ).
segments.en: Through Truth, the Holy One Blessed He does with him kindness that is not dressed in  Din (judgement) .

segments.he:
לד.

עַל־יְדֵי דַּעַת נִמְשָׁךְ חֶסֶד.
segments.en: That which the Holy One Blessed He hides His Countenance from you, it is because of the blasphemy that is within you.

segments.he:
לה.

עַל־יְדֵי צְדָקָה שֶּׁנּוֹתְנִין לְאָדָם הָגוּן, תִּזְכֶּה לְהַמְשִׁיךְ חֶסֶד גַּם לְאוֹהַבְךָ.
segments.en: Through trust  (in G-d),  the judgment is sweetened and kindness is drawn forth.

segments.he:
לו.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל תּוֹכָחָה, יִסּוּרִין בָּאִין עָלָיו.
segments.en: Through faith, you can direct the blessed G-d to do your will.

segments.he:
לז.

לְהַמְתָּקַת הַדִּינִין תֹּאמַר קַפִּיטְל ל"ט  [לַמְנַצֵּחַ ל ִ י דוּתוּן].
segments.en: Through charity, one transforms judgment and  Din  to the attribute of kindness.

segments.he:
לח.

מִי שֶׁמְּחַזֵּק אֶת עַצְמוֹ קֹדֶם הַתְּפִלָּה וְעוֹשֶׂה הֲכָנָה גְדוֹלָה, אַף־עַל־פִּי שֶׁאַחַר־כָּךְ אֵינוֹ מִתְפַּלֵּל כָּרָאוּי, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יִסּוּרִין בְּדֵלִין מִמֶּנּוּ.
segments.en: Someone who does not have faith, it is certain that the Holy One Blessed He has removed His kindness from him.

segments.he:
לט.

לְהַמְתָּקַת הַדִּינִין, תַּגִּיד מִשְׁנָיוֹת "זְרָעִים".
segments.en: When harsh decrees prevail, and kindness is rare  (lit. precious)  and not found, know that crying is helpful for this.

segments.he:
מ.

לִפְעָמִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מְכַלֶּה הַצָּרוֹת עַל הָאָב, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם לִבְנוֹ.
segments.en: (I heard from his holy mouth, at the time when I transcribed this before him, that a hint for this is in the verse: "How precious is Your kindness, G-d ( Tehillim  36:8)" – Explaining as follows, when kindness is rare (precious), and unavailable, that is  dinim  prevail G-d forbid, then the action to be taken for this: (the continuation of the verse) "And people in the shadow of Your wings take refuge." The initials (of the last three words) spell out "crying", because crying helps for this, as previously stated).

segments.he:
מא.

עַל־יְדֵי נֶדֶר נִתְעַכֵּב הַחֵמָה שֶׁל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.
segments.en: Through cognizance, kindness is drawn forth.

segments.he:
מב.

לְהַמְתָּקַת הַדִּינִין תֹּאמַר קַפִּיטְל ע"ז.
segments.en: Through giving charity to an upright man, you will merit to draw kindness also to your friends.

segments.he:
מג.

מִי שֶׁמְּקַשֵּׁר אֶת עַצְמוֹ בַּלַּיְלָה לְמִדַּת אֱמוּנָה, נִמְתָּק מֵעָלָיו הַדִּין.
segments.en: Someone who does not accept rebuke, suffering comes upon him.

segments.he:
מד.

עַל־יְדֵי גַּאֲוָה נִסְתַּלֵּק הַחֶסֶד לְמַעְלָה.
segments.en: To sweeten  Dinim , recite  Tehillim (Psalms) , Chapter 39. [ Lamnatzayach Al Yidusun (starting words)].

segments.he:
מה.

עַל־יְדֵי תִּקּוּן חֲצוֹת נִמְתָּק הַדִּין.
segments.en: Someone who strengthens himself before prayer and prepares himself thoroughly  (lit.  greatly ) , even if afterwards he does not pray appropriately, through this suffering separates from him.

segments.he:
מו.

כְּשֶׁתִּהְיֶה נֵעוֹר כָּל הַלַּיְלָה, בָּזֶה אַתָּה נִצּוֹל מִדִּינִים.
segments.en: To sweeten  Dinim , say  (learn)  Mishnayot  of Zeraim.

segments.he:
מז.

עַל־יְדֵי הַצָּרוֹת שֶׁבָּאִין עַל אָדָם, יָכוֹל לְהַשִּׂיג וּלְהָבִין אֶת עֲווֹנוֹתָיו.
segments.en: Sometimes the Holy One Blessed He expends all the suffering on the father, so that his son will have peace.

segments.he:
מח.

עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁבָּא אֶל הַצַּדִּיק, בִּיאָתוֹ בְּעַצְמָהּ יְכוֹלָה לְהַמְתִּיק הַדִּינִין.
segments.en: Through  (making)  a vow, the fury of the blessed G-d is forestalled.

segments.he:
מט.

גַּם הַמָּעוֹת שֶּׁנּוֹתְנִין לַצַּדִּיק, הַנְּתִינָה בְּעַצְמָהּ מַמְתִּיק הַדִּין.
segments.en: To sweeten  Dinim , say  Tehillim (Psalms)  Chapter 77.

segments.he:
נ.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת חוֹשְׁבִים עָלָיו לְמַעְלָה לְרָע לוֹ.
segments.en: Someone who attaches himself at night to the quality of faith, the  Din (judgement)  upon him is sweetened.

segments.he:
נא.

עַל־יְדֵי לִמּוּד תּוֹרָה יָשׁוּבוּ הַמְקַטְּרְגִים אָחוֹר.
segments.en: Through arrogance, kindness departs rising above  (to the heaven).

segments.he:
נב.

כְּשֶׁהוֹלֵךְ וְנוֹפֵל ,  לִפְעָמִים  נִגְזַר עָלָיו לָמוּת, וְעַכְשָׁו נִת ְבַּטֵּל עַל־יְדֵי הַנְּפִילָה.
segments.en: Through saying  Tikkun Chatzot (Midnight  Rectification – special regiment of prayers said at midnight) , the judgment is sweetened.

segments.he:
נג.

עַל הַגְּזֵרוֹת רָעוֹת, שֶׁאֻמּוֹת גּוֹזְרִין עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, יֹאמְרוּ קַפִּיטְל ס"ב.
segments.en: When you stay awake the whole night, by this you are saved from  Dinim .

segments.he:
נד.

עַל־יְדֵי יְשִׁיבָה בַּמִּקְוֶה תַּחַת הַמַּיִם, עַד שֶׁלֹּא יוּכַל לְהַחֲזִיק בְּעַצְמוֹ הָרוּחַ וְהַנְּשִׁימָה, נִמְתָּק הַדִּין.
segments.en: Through troubles that come upon a man, he can grasp and understand his sins.

segments.he:
נה.

לִפְעָמִים הַיַּיִן מְעוֹרֵר דִּין.
segments.en: Through that which one comes to the  T zaddik , the coming in its own right can sweeten the  Dinim .

segments.he:
נו.

הַנּוֹתֵן פִּתּוֹ לְמִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ דֵּעָה יִסּוּרִין בָּאִין עָלָיו.
segments.en: Also the money that is given to the  T zaddik , the giving itself sweetens the  Din (judgement) .

segments.he:
נז.

מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ דֵּעָה, לְסוֹף גּוֹלֶה.
segments.en: Due to depression, thoughts are aligned in Heaven for his detriment.

segments.he:
נח.

בַּת דִּינָא בָּטֵל דִּינָא.
segments.en: Through learning the Torah, accusers will retreat.

segments.he:
נט.

הַלּוֹמֵד תּוֹרָה לִשְׁמָהּ, מֵשִׂים שָׁלוֹם בְּפָמַלְיָא שֶׁל מַעְלָה וּבְפָמַלְיָא שֶׁל מַטָּה.
segments.en: When one who goes and falls occasionally, he had been decreed to die, and now it is annulled through the falling (See also above #21) .

segments.he:
ס.

הַקּוֹרֵא פָּסוּק בִּזְמַנּוֹ, מֵבִיא טוֹבָה לָעוֹלָם.
segments.en: For the evil decrees that the nations decree on Israel, they should say  Tehillim (Psalms)  Chapter 62.

segments.he:
סא.

יֵשׁ עִתִּים וּמְקוֹמוֹת מְזֻמָּנִים לְטוֹבָה וְהוּא הַדִּין לְהֵפֶךְ.
segments.en: Through staying in a  Mikveh under the water, until one can no longer hold his breath, the  Din  is sweetened.

segments.he:
סב.

לִפְעָמִים מִתְעַכֵּב הַדִּין עַל־יְדֵי רֹאשׁ הַדּוֹר וְלִפְעָמִים עַל־יְדֵי הַדּוֹר.
segments.en: Sometimes wine arouses  Din (judgement) .

segments.he:
סג.

עַל־יְדֵי הַשּׂוֹנְאִים יָכוֹל לֵידַע הַדִּין שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה.
segments.en: One who gives his bread to someone lacking cognizance, suffering comes upon him.

segments.he:
סד.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם מְסַפֵּר לַחֲבֵרוֹ צַעֲרוֹ, צָרִיךְ הַשּׁוֹמֵעַ לְהַחְכִּים בִּשְׁעַת הַשְּׁמִיעָה, שֶׁלֹּא יָבוֹא עָלָיו הַצַּעַר הַזֶּה.
segments.en: Someone without cognizance eventually is exiled.

segments.he:
סה.

הָעוֹסֵק בַּתּוֹרָהּ בַּלַּיְלָה, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מוֹשֵׁךְ עָלָיו חוּט שֶׁל חֶסֶד בַּיּוֹם.
segments.en: A judgment that was forestalled overnight, the judgment is annulled.

segments.he:
סו.

צָרִיךְ לִתֵּן מָמוֹן עַל פִּדְיוֹן.
segments.en: One who learns Torah for the sake of Heaven, sets peace in the Upper Tribunal and in the Lower Tribunal.

segments.he:
סז.

כָּל זְמַן שֶׁתּוּכַל לְהִנָּצֵל עַל־יְדֵי מָמוֹן, אַל תְּשַׁמֵּשׁ בִּתְפִלּוֹת.
segments.en: One who reads a scriptural verse in its time, brings good to the world.

segments.he:
סח.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ פְּלֻגְתָּא לְמַעְלָה בְּאֵיזֶה דָּבָר, הֵם סוֹמְכִין אֶת עַצְמָן עַל הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה.
segments.en: There are times and places destined for good, and the opposite is also true.

segments.he:
סט.

68. When there is a disagreement Above on some matter, they rely  (lit. support themselves)  on the  (opinion of the) T zaddik  in this world.
segments.en: Sometimes a decree is forestalled by the Leader of the Generation, and sometimes by the people of the generation.

segments.he:
ע.

בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁדָּנִים אֶת הָאָדָם לְמַעְלָה, דָּנִין שְׁמוֹ, וְלִפְעָמִים הַשְּׁלוּחִים מַחֲלִיפִין בְּשֵׁם אַחֵר, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא הַמָּוֶת אוֹ הַצָּרָה עַל אָדָם אַחֵר.
segments.en: Through one's enemies, one can know the decree of Above.

segments.he:
עא.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְבַקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים עַל דּוֹרוֹ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נֶעֱנָשׁ.
segments.en: When a man tells his suffering to a friend, the listener must act wisely at the time of hearing, so that the same suffering will not come upon him.

segments.he:
עב.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ חוֹלֶה אוֹ צַעַר בְּבֵיתוֹ, יֵלֵךְ אֵצֶל הֶחָכָם וִיבַקֵּשׁ עָלָיו רַחֲמִים אוֹ שֶׁיְּבָרֵךְ אוֹתוֹ.
segments.en: One who studies Torah in the night, the Holy One Blessed He draws upon him a thread of kindness in the day.

segments.he:
עג.

כְּשֶׁשּׁוֹמְעִין שֶׁאֶחָד מְקַטְרֵג עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל צְרִיכִין הַשּׁוֹמְעִין לְלַמֵּד בְּפִיהֶם זְכוּת עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וּצְרִיכִין לִטְרֹחַ כְּדֵי לִמְצֹא זְכוּת.
segments.en: One must give money for a  P idyon (lit. redemption. Money is given to a  tzaddik  who redeems the contributor from any judgments) .

segments.he:
עד.

כְּשֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא רוֹאֶה, שֶׁמְּקַנְּאִין לִכְבוֹדוֹ, עַל־י ְדֵי זֶה מֵשִׁיב חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ.
segments.en: As long as you can be saved through money, do not use prayers.

segments.he:
עה.

עִקַּר הַפִּדְיוֹן אוֹ הַתְּפִלָּה אֵינוֹ אֶלָּא בַּיּוֹם.
segments.en: In the moment when a person is being judged above, they judge his name. Sometimes the messengers switch it with another name, and through this the decree of death or hardship comes on someone else.

segments.he:
עו.

אֵין הַכֹּל כְּשֵׁרִין לַעֲשׂוֹת פִּדְיוֹן.
segments.en: Someone who does not pray  (lit. ask)  for mercy for his generation, through this he is punished.

segments.he:
עז.

מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לְהַמְתִּיק דִּינִים, אַל יִשְׁתֶּה יַיִן כָּל הַיּוֹם.
segments.en: Someone who has a sick person or pain in his house should go to a Torah sage, that he should pray  (lit. ask)  for  mercy on his behalf, or that he  (the Torah sage)  should bless him.

segments.he:
עח.

בַּעֲנָוָה מְרַצִּין אֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא.
segments.en: When it is heard that someone is making accusations on the Jewish people, those who hear should speak aloud of the  merits of Israel  (show a meritorious interpretation of the actions that brought on the accusation),  and it is necessary to strive to find merit.

segments.he:
עט.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ דִּין יִתְפַּלֵּל בְּהִתְלַהֲבוּת.
segments.en: When the Holy One Blessed He sees that people are zealous for His honor, through this He retracts His anger.

segments.he:
פ.

בִּנְיַן הַבַּיִת שֶׁל אֲבָנִים הוּא סַכָּנַת מִיתָה.
segments.en: The primary  Pidyon (redemption, see above 66)  or prayer is only in t he day.

segments.he:
פא.

הַצְּדָקָה מַמְתִּיק הַדִּין.
segments.en: Not everyone is fitting to make a  Pidyon  (redemption,  see above 66).

segments.he:
פב.

הַמִּקְוֶה מַמְתִּיק הַדִּין.
segments.en: One who wants to sweeten  Dinim  should not drink any wine the whole day.

segments.he:
פג.

אַחַר הַגְּזַר־דִּין צָרִיךְ לְהַלְבִּישׁ אֶת הַתְּפִלָּה בְּסִפּוּרֵי מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת.
segments.en: With humility, one can find favor with the Holy One Blessed He.

segments.he:
פד.

עַל־יְדֵי פְּתִיחַת סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה נִמְתָּק הַדִּין וְנִתְיַשֵּׁב עַל מְקוֹמוֹ.
segments.en: When there is a  Din (judgement) , pray with fervor.

segments.he:
פה.

עַל־יְדֵי הַשְּׁתִיקָה נִמְתָּק הַדִּין.
segments.en: Building a stone house entails danger of death.

segments.he:
פו.

הַצּוֹם וְשַׂק הֵם סְגֻלָּה לְבַטֵּל גְּזֵרָה.
segments.en: Charity sweetens harsh judgment.

segments.he:
פז.

לְהַמְתִּיק הַדִּין תֹּאמַר הַפָּרָשָׁה שֶׁל אַחַת־עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעוֹת עִזִּים  (שְׁמוֹת כו,לו),  וּקְטֹרֶת  (שְׁמוֹת ל')  וְאַחַת־עֶשְׂרֵה בְּרָכוֹת שֶׁבֵּרַךְ מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים  (דְּבָרִים לג)  וּמֶרְכָּבָה שֶׁל יְחֶזְקֵאל  (יְחֶזְקֵאל א').
segments.en: The  (immersing in a)  Mikveh sweetens harsh judgment.

segments.he:
פח.

וּפָרָשַׁת נְדָרִים  (בּ ַ מִדְבַּר ל')  וּמִשְׁנָיוֹת שֶׁל מַסֶּכֶת שְׁבוּעוֹת.
segments.en: After a decree has been passed, one needs to enclothe the prayer within stories  (t.n. explained in Likutay Moharan, Torah 5).

segments.he:
פט.

עַל־יְדֵי הַכְנָעָה מְבַטֵּל הַדִּין.
segments.en: Through the opening of a Torah scroll, judgment is sweetened, and it is settled in its place.

segments.he:
צ.

עַל־יְדֵי שִׁיר־הַשִּׁירִים נִמְתָּקִים הַדִּינִים.
segments.en: Through silence, the judgment is sweetened.

segments.he:
צא.

מִי שֶׁאֶפְשָׁר לוֹ לַעֲסֹק בַּתּוֹרָה, וְאֵינוֹ עוֹסֵק, יִסּוּרִין בָּאִין עָלָיו.
segments.en: Fasting and sackcloth are conducive to annull an edict.

segments.he:
צב.

מַסֶּכֶת אָהֳלוֹת מְסֻגָּל לְהַמְתִּיק הַדִּין.
segments.en: To sweeten the judgment, say the Torah portion concerning the eleven goatskin curtains  (that served as roof for the Tabernacles - Shemot 26:7-14, 36:14-19) , and the Ketoress  (incense,  Shemot 30:34-38) , the eleven blessings that Moshe gave to the tribes  (Devarim 33:6-25) , and the Chariot of Yehezkel  (Yehezkel 1 ) .

segments.he:
צג.

מִי שֶׁמְּגַדֵּל כֶּלֶב, מְעוֹרֵר דִּין.
segments.en: And the portion about vows  (Bamidbar 30)  and  M ishnayot  of the Tractate of  Shavuot .

segments.he:
צד.

לִפְעָמִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַפִּיל אֶת הָרָשָׁע לְאֵיזֶהוּ צָרָה, שֶׁיֵּלֵךְ אֵצֶל הַצַּדִּיק וִיבַקְשׁוֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל עָלָיו.
segments.en: Through submission  (-before G-d) , a decree is annulled.

segments.he:
צה.

הַמְתָּקַת הַדִּינִים הוּא עַל־יְדֵי הַגּוֹרָל כְּמוֹ לַעֲזָאזֵל.  (פֵּרוּשׁ דָּבָר זֶה שָׁמַעְתִּי מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ בִּשְׁעַת כְּתִיבָתִי לְפָנָיו, שֶׁיִּקַּח שְׁנֵי מַטְבְּעוֹת וְיַפִּיל עֲלֵיהֶם גּוֹרָל, גּוֹרָל אֶחָד לַה' וְגוֹרָל אֶחָד לַעֲזָאזֵל. וְהַמַּטְבֵּעַ שֶׁעָלָה עָלֶיהָ הַגּוֹרָל לַה' יִתֵּן אוֹתָהּ לִצְדָקָה, וְהַשְּׁנִיָּה שֶׁעָלָה עָלֶיהָ הַגּוֹרָל לַעֲזָאזֵל יַשְׁלִיךְ אוֹתָהּ לְאִבּוּד, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִמְתָּק הַדִּינִים)
segments.en: Through the Song of Songs, decrees are annulled.

segments.he:
צו.

לִפְעָמִים צַדִּיק הַדּוֹר בְּכַעֲסוֹ, שֶׁיִּכְעַס עָלֶיךָ מַמְתִּיק דִּינִים.
segments.en: One who is able to engage in Torah, and does not, suffering comes upon him.

segments.he:
צז.

כְּשֶׁקָּם מֶלֶךְ חָדָשׁ בָּאֻמּוֹת אוֹ שַׂר חָדָשׁ, אֲזַי הַדִּין נִתְעוֹרֵר.
segments.en: The Tractate Ohalot  (Tents - dealing with the parameters of impurity)  is conducive to annulling decrees.

segments.he:
צח.

עַל־יְדֵי קַשְׁיוּת עֹרֶף כְּנֶגֶד הַתְּשׁוּבָה, מֵבִיא עַל עַצְמוֹ ש ֶׁבֶר גָּדוֹל בְּאֵין מַרְפֵּא.
segments.en: One who raises a dog arouses  Din (judgement) .

segments.he:
צט.

לֹא טוֹב לִשְׁנֵי בְּנֵי־אָדָם שֶׁשְּׁמוֹתֵיהֶן שָׁוִים, שֶׁיָּדוּרוּ בְּדִירָה אֶחָת.
segments.en: Sometimes, the Holy One Blessed be He pushes a wicked person down into some hardship, in order that he go to the  T zaddik  and ask that he  (the Tzadik)  pray on his behalf.

segments.he:
ק.

97. Through being stiff-necked against repentance, one brings on himself a great breakdown which has no healing.
segments.en: Sweetening the  Dinim  is through casting lots, as with  (the goat sent)  to  Azazel (on  Yom Kippur ).

segments.he:
קא.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת מְעוֹרֵר הַדִּין.
segments.en: (The explanation of this matter I heard from his (Rabbi Nachman) holy mouth, at the time when I wrote this before him: That one should take two coins, and cast upon them lots -- one lot “to G-d”, and one lot “to  Azazel ”. The coin that on it came up the lot "to G-d" should be given to charity, and the second one that on it came up “to  Azazel ” should be thrown away (destroyed), and through this the judgment is sweetened.)

segments.he:
קב.

עַל־יְדֵי הַבּוּשָׁה נִמְתָּק הַדִּין.
segments.en: Sometimes when the  T zaddik  of the Generation with his anger that he is angry at you, he sweetens judgments.

segments.he:
קג.

צָרִיךְ לְהוֹדִיעַ צַעֲרוֹ לָרַבִּים.
segments.en: When a new king arises among the nations or a new minister, then the  Din (judgement)  is aroused.

segments.he:
קד.

כְּשֶׁנִּתָּן רְשׁוּת לַמַּשְׁחִית, אֵין מַבְחִין בֵּין צַדִּיק לְרָשָׁע, וְלֹא עוֹד אֶלָּא שֶׁמַּתְחִיל מֵהַצַּדִּיק.
segments.en: It is not good for two people with the same name to dwell in the same home  (lit. in one home).

segments.he:
קה.

שִׁנּוּי מָקוֹם קוֹרֵעַ גְּזַר־דִּין.
segments.en: Through depression, one arouses harsh judgment.

segments.he:
קו.

עַל־יְדֵי הָרַחֲמָנוּת מַמְתִּיק הַדִּין.
segments.en: Through abashment the  Din (judgement)  is sweetened.

segments.he:
קז.

לִפְעָמִים אָדָם מֵת מֵחֲמַת פַּחַד אוֹ מִיתָה אַחֶרֶת פִּתְאוֹמִית, תַּאֲמִין שֶׁזֶּה הָעֵת וְהַזְּמַן שֶׁלּוֹ.
segments.en: One should make known his suffering to the public (See also above #15) .

segments.he:
קח.

עַל־יְדֵי הַשִּׁפְלוּת יוּכַל לְבַטֵּל גְּזַר־דִּין.
segments.en: When authority is given to a destructive angel, he doesn't differentiate between the righteous and the evil. Furthermore, he even starts with the righteous.

segments.he:
קט.

עַל־יְדֵי שִׁמּוּשׁ צַדִּיקִים נִמְתָּק הַדִּין.
segments.en: A change of place tears up an edict.

segments.he:
קי.

בִּזְכוּת בִּקּוּר־חוֹלִים אֵין מֵת מִתּוֹךְ יִסּוּרִין.
segments.en: Through having mercy one sweetens the  Din (judgement) .

segments.he:
קיא.

כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִגִּיעַ מִדַּת־הַדִּין שֶׁל מַעְלָה עַל הָאָדָם, אַף־עַל־פִּי שֶׁעֲדַיִן אֵינָם שׁוֹלְטִין עָלָיו, יָכוֹל לְהַרְגִּישׁ אֶת מִדַּת־הַדִּין עַל־יְדֵי הַזְּבוּבִים שֶׁבַּבַּיִת.
segments.en: Sometimes a man dies from fear or some other sudden death, believe that this was his appointed time.

segments.he:
קיב.

חֵלֶק שֵׁנִי
segments.en: Through a lowly bearing, one can annul a harsh decree.

segments.he:
קיג.

מִי שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְהַמְתִּיק דִּינִים, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בְּנָקֵל לוֹ לְקַדֵּשׁ הַשֵּׁם בְּלִי מוֹנֵעַ גַּם עֵינָיו אֵינָם כֵּהוֹת.
segments.en: Through attending to  tzaddikim , the judgment is sweetened.

segments.he:
קיד.

עַל־יְדֵי הַצָּרוֹת נַעֲשׂוּ עֲטָרוֹת.
segments.en: In the merit of visiting the sick, one will not have a painful death.

segments.he:
קטו.

מִי שֶׁמְּקַבֵּל יִסּוּרִים בִּשְׁבִיל לְהָקֵל יִסּוּרִים מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יִזְכֶּה לְרוּחַ־הַקֹּדֶשׁ.
segments.en: When the measure  (attribute)  of  Din (judgement)  of Above reaches a man, even if it has not begun to prevail over him, one can sense the measure  (attribute)  of  Din  through the flies that are in the house.

segments.he:
קטז.

פָּרָשִׁיּוֹת הַמּוֹעֲדִים הַכְּתוּבִים בְּפָרָשַׁת פִּינְחָס – מְסֻגָּלִים בִּקְרִיאָתָם לְבַטֵּל דִּינִים, וּמְסֻגָּלִים לִזְכּוֹת בְּדִינֵי עַכּוּ"ם.
segments.en: SECOND PART:

segments.he:
קיז.

עַל־יְדֵי צְדָקָה מַמְתִּיק הַדִּין שֶׁל לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא, הַיְנוּ יוֹם הַדִּין שֶׁל עָתִיד לָבוֹא.
segments.en: One who works to sweeten judgments, through this it will be easy for him to sanctify G-d's name, without prevention. Also, his eyes will not become dim.

segments.he:
קיח.

מִי שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ ,  כְּשֶׁרוֹאֶה  אֵיזֶהוּ דִּין עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, לַהֲפֹךְ אֶת הַדִּין עַל אֶחָד מֵאֻמּוֹת בִּבְחִינַת "וָאֶתֵּן אָדָם תַּחְתֶּךָ", עַל־יְדֵי זֶה [כָּל] הַנִּבְרָאִים מַחֲזִירִים כֹּחָם וְנִכְלָלִים בּוֹ בְּזֶה הָאִישׁ, כְּדֵי לְחַדֵּשׁ כֹּחָם, גַּם עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִפְתָּח הַשַּׁעַר שֶׁל מִינֵי מְשָׁלִים בָּעוֹלָם.
segments.en: Through suffering, crowns are made.

segments.he:
קיט.

אֵלּוּ גּוֹמְלֵי־חֲסָדִים, הָעוֹשִׂים חֶסֶד וְלִפְעָמִים גּוֹרְמִים עִם הַחֶסֶד לְרָעָה וְעוֹשִׂים עַצְמָן כּ ְאִלּוּ אֵינָם רוֹאִים הָרָעָה הַצּוֹמַחַת מֵחַסְדָּם, וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת הָאַזְהָרָה שֶׁהִזְהִיר לַכֹּהֲנִים בְּחִינַת חֶסֶד "שֶׁלֹּא יַפְסִיעוּ פְּסִיעָה גַסָּה", עַל־יְדֵי זֶה גּוֹרְמִים שֶׁהַדִּין שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, אֵינוֹ בִּמְתִינוּת. וְכֵן לְהֵפֶךְ, כְּשֶׁמְּדַקְדְּקִים בְּחַסְדָּם, שֶׁלֹּא יַצְמִיחַ רָעָה, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה הַדִּין בִּמְתִינוּת.
segments.en: One who accepts suffering in order to lessen the suffering of the Jewish people, through this he will merit Divine Inspiration.

segments.he:
קכ.

מִי שֶׁבּוֹעֵט בְּיִסּוּרִין, כְּאִלּוּ אוֹמֵר לָאֵל: סוּר מִמֶּנִּי.
segments.en: The portions on the festivals written in the  (Torah)  portion of Pinchas are conducive  ( segula h )  through reading them to annul  Dinim , and they are conducive to triumph under the gentile legislation.

segments.he:
121.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם לוֹמֵד עַד שֶׁנִּתְיַגֵּעַ, בָּזֶה מַמְתִּיק דִּינִים וּמְעוֹרֵר רַחֲמִים, גַּם עַל־יְדֵי זֶה מְעוֹרֵר רַחֲמִים אֵצֶל אָבִיו בַּקֶּבֶר.
segments.en: Through charity, one sweetens the judgments of the Time to Come, that is, of the Day of Judgment in the Time to Come.

segments.he:
122.

לְפַיֵּס מִדַּת הַדִּין אֵינוֹ בְּיָדַיִם רֵיקָנִיּוֹת.
segments.en: One who knows, when he sees a  Din (judgement)  on Israel, to flip the  Din  onto another nation, in the aspect of "and I will put a man in your place" (Isaiah 43:4),  through this all the creations return their power and become included in him – in this man, in order to renew their power. Also through this the gate of various parables is opened in the world.

segments.he:
123.

מִי שֶׁכֶּלֶב נְשָׁכוֹ, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁרַחֲמֵי הַשֵּׁם מְסֻלָּקִים מִמֶּנּוּ, גַּם בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁנִּכְשַׁל בְּמַאֲכָלוֹת אֲסוּרוֹת.
segments.en: Those benefactors of kindness, who do kindness and sometimes cause - through the kindness they do – something bad, and they pretend they do not see the bad which resulted from their kindness. This is the aspect of the warning given to the  Cohanim (priests),  who are the aspect of kindness, not to take large steps  (end of the portion of Yisro, Shemos).  Through this, they cause the Judgment Above to be without deliberation. Also the opposite: When they take particular care in their kindness, that evil should not result from it, through this the Judgment Above is with deliberation.

segments.he:
124.

לִפְעָמִים מַסְתִּירִין אֶת הָאָדָם מִמִּדַּת־הַדִּין, בָּזֶה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק מַגְבִּיהַּ וּמִתְפָּאֵר אֶת עַצְמוֹ עַל [וּמַשְׁפִּיל אֶת] זֶה הָאָדָם.
segments.en: One who rebels  (lit. kicks)  against suffering is as if he says to G-d, "Leave me!"
When a man learns until he is exhausted, through this he sweetens judgments and arouses mercy. Also through this, he arouses mercy for  (lit. by)  his father in the grave.
Appeasement of the Measure  (attribute)  of Judgment is not  (can not be accomplished)  with empty hands.
One who was bitten by a dog, it is certain that G-d's mercy has been withdrawn from him. Also, it is certain that he has transgressed with  (eating)  forbidden foods.
Sometimes a man is hidden from the Measure  (attribute)  of Judgment, with this that the  T zaddik  exalts and glorifies himself over the man and casts him down.
